title: Prognostic Value of Preoperative Fibrinogen in Metastatic Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Patients Undergoing Cytoreductive Nephrectomy.
snippet: To investigate the prognostic association of preoperative plasma fibrinogen (FIB) levels with overall survival (OS) in patients with metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma (mccRCC) undergoing cytoreductive nephrectomy (CN).
